data.long_meaning: Jai is a Sanskrit name meaning 'Victory, Triumph'. It is derived from the Sanskrit root 'jai' which means 'to conquer, to be victorious'. In Hindu mythology, Jai is a name of Lord Vishnu and is also used as a battle cry. The name Jai carries the meaning “Victory, Triumph” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jai usually hope their child will grow to embody victory, triumph and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes victory over inner and outer struggles.
data.etymology: Jai belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory, Triumph.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jai total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
